headline: Friday morning: Dhaka air 5th worst in world
summary: The capital's air quality index has plummeted, ranking the city among the most polluted globally on Friday morning.
details: Dhaka has been ranked as the 5th most polluted city in the world on Friday morning.
The city's air quality index (AQI) has reached dangerous levels, posing significant health risks to residents.
High levels of particulate matter in the air are contributing to this severe pollution ranking.
Residents are often advised to wear masks and limit outdoor activities during such spikes in pollution.
